Resolve the NWFVA output directory for a given output kind

Source: R/naming.R
nwfva_output_dir.Rd

NWFVA organises outputs under {root}/{region}/{platform}/{year}/{campaign}/{product}/..., branching into daten/ for point clouds, doku/vpc/ for VPC metadata, and doku/overview/ for overview images.

Usage

nwfva_output_dir(
  root,
  region,
  platform,
  year,
  campaign,
  product,
  kind = c("pointcloud", "vpc", "overview")
)

Arguments

root

Character. Root output directory (e.g. raw_to_processed()'s out_dir).

region, platform, year, campaign, product

Character. Path components.

kind

One of "pointcloud", "vpc", "overview".

Value

Character scalar path (not yet created on disk).
